description: Update a short link. confirmed=false (default) returns the current link and the changes without writing; confirmed=true applies them.

confirmed.description: false (default) returns a preview without writing; true applies the change.

deepLinkApp.description: Native app that opens the link on mobile; targetUrl must belong to it. null turns it off.

expiredRedirectUrl.description: Where visitors go after the link expires; null clears it.

anyOf.description: Expiry as YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO date-time with offset.

expiresAt.description: Expiry date or datetime; null removes the expiry.

externalId.description: Your own ID for the link, such as a CRM record; null clears it.

folderId.description: Existing link folder id. Use null to leave the link unfiled or clear the folder.

folderSlug.description: Existing link folder slug. Use this or folderId, never a display name.

id.description: Link ID from list_links or search_links.

ogDescription.description: Social preview description; null clears it.

ogImageUrl.description: Social preview image URL; null clears it.

ogTitle.description: Social preview title; null clears it.

name: update_link
title: Update link
